<style>
body {
    font-family: Arial, sans-serif;
    background-color: #e6f4ff;
    padding: 20px;
}
#app-container {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: center;
    gap: 40px;
    max-width: 1600px;
    margin: 0 auto;
}
.text-block {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    flex: 1;
}
.text-section {
    margin-bottom: 20px;
}
.text-section h3 {
    margin: 0 0 10px 0;
    font-size: 16px;
    color: #333;
    text-align: center;
}
textarea {
    width: 100%;
    box-sizing: border-box;
    border-radius: 12px;
    padding: 16px;
    font-size: 16px;
    resize: none;
    border: 1px solid #888;
    box-shadow: 0 0 10px rgba(0,0,0,0.1);
}
.words-textarea {
    height: 250px;
}
.code-textarea {
    height: 100px;
    font-family: monospace;
    font-size: 14px;
}
#buttons {
    margin-top: 30px;
    display: flex;
    justify-content: center;
    gap: 20px;
    width: 100%;
}
button {
    padding: 14px 28px;
    background-color: #00aee3;
    color: white;
    border: none;
    border-radius: 10px;
    cursor: pointer;
    font-size: 16px;
    font-weight: bold;
}
button:hover {
    background-color: #0095c7;
}
button:disabled {
    background-color: #888;
    cursor: not-allowed;
}
</style>

<h1 style="text-align:center; font-size:32px; color:#005b8f; margin-bottom:30px;">Text Encryption</h1>
<div id="app-container">
<div class="text-block">
<div class="text-section">
<h3>Original Text</h3>
<textarea id="input-words" class="words-textarea" placeholder="Enter text here..."></textarea>
</div>
<div class="text-section">
<h3>Original Code</h3>
<textarea id="input-code" class="code-textarea" placeholder="Enter or edit code here..."></textarea>
</div>
</div>
<div class="text-block">
<div class="text-section">
<h3>Scrambled Text</h3>
<textarea id="output-words" class="words-textarea" placeholder="Scrambled text will appear here..." readonly></textarea>
</div>
<div class="text-section">
<h3>Scrambled Code</h3>
<textarea id="output-code" class="code-textarea" placeholder="Scrambled code will appear here..." readonly></textarea>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<div id="buttons">
<button onclick="scrambleText()">Scramble</button>
<button onclick="descrambleText()">Descramble</button>
<button onclick="clearText()">Clear</button>
</div>

<script>
function scrambleWord(word) {
    if (word.length <= 3) return word;
    const middle = word.slice(1, -1).split('').sort(() => 0.5 - Math.random()).join('');
    return word[0] + middle + word[word.length - 1];
}

function scrambleText() {
    const input = document.getElementById('input-words').value.trim();
    if (!input) return;
    
    const words = input.split(/\s+/);
    const original = words.map((word, i) => ({ word, index: i + 1 }));
    const scrambled = [...original];
    
    // Shuffle scrambled list
    for (let i = scrambled.length - 1; i > 0; i--) {
        const j = Math.floor(Math.random() * (i + 1));
        [scrambled[i], scrambled[j]] = [scrambled[j], scrambled[i]];
    }
    
    // Build output text
    const scrambledText = scrambled.map(obj => obj.word).join(' ');
    
    // Build code: original index → new position
    const outputCode = original
        .map(orig => {
            const newIndex = scrambled.findIndex(w => w.index === orig.index) + 1;
            return `${orig.index}.${newIndex}`;
        })
        .join(', ');
    
    // Create original sequence code
    const originalCode = original.map(obj => `${obj.index}.${obj.index}`).join(', ');
    
    document.getElementById('input-code').value = originalCode;
    document.getElementById('output-words').value = scrambledText;
    document.getElementById('output-code').value = outputCode;
}

function descrambleText() {
    const scrambledWords = document.getElementById('output-words').value.trim();
    const scrambledCode = document.getElementById('output-code').value.trim();
    
    if (!scrambledWords || !scrambledCode) {
        alert('No scrambled text and code found to descramble!');
        return;
    }
    
    // Parse the code
    const mappings = scrambledCode.split(', ').map(pair => {
        const [original, scrambled] = pair.split('.');
        return { original: parseInt(original), scrambled: parseInt(scrambled) };
    });
    
    // Get scrambled words
    const wordsArray = scrambledWords.split(/\s+/);
    
    // Reconstruct original order
    const originalWords = new Array(wordsArray.length);
    mappings.forEach(mapping => {
        originalWords[mapping.original - 1] = wordsArray[mapping.scrambled - 1];
    });
    
    const originalText = originalWords.join(' ');
    document.getElementById('input-words').value = originalText;
    
    // Update original code
    const originalCode = mappings.map(m => `${m.original}.${m.original}`).join(', ');
    document.getElementById('input-code').value = originalCode;
}

function clearText() {
    document.getElementById('input-words').value = '';
    document.getElementById('input-code').value = '';
    document.getElementById('output-words').value = '';
    document.getElementById('output-code').value = '';
}
</script>
